## Description (first paragraph)

Drive the Hermes app's FastAPI backend directly over REST -- "every button and
function" -- without the (restart-looping) Electron renderer. Use this to read or
change Hermes settings in real time, inspect/edit cron jobs, MCP servers, env vars,
model selection, and sessions.
